title: Walking with empty hands by about 18 months
summary: Most children walk without holding on by about 18 months.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 18-month page says walks without holding on to a person or anything. The page places that line among things most children do by 18 months. This is independent walking, not a two-step burst and not a jog. Arriving at the skill later is not diagnosed here. The month is an American checklist month. No handhold remains in the 18-month wording for independent walking. No handhold remains inside the 18-month wording for independent walking.
